values.note: Book Now goes to the operator's Firefly page. Cancel at least 7 days ahead for stays under a month ($25 fee), 14 days for longer stays ($100); no refunds after arrival. Office open Tue-Sat 9-5, closed Sun-Mon; check-in 1 PM, check-out noon.

note: Family campground on US-19 (S Suncoast Blvd) south of Homosassa. No pool or pickleball; a paver patio with a built-in fire pit on every site but the two pull-throughs, and a fenced dog area. --Claude
